description: Bornes de recharge électrique du SDE35 dans le département d'Ille-et-Vilaine is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Départemental d'Energie d'Ille-et-Vilaine. This dataset references the charging points of electric charging stations (or IRVE - Infrastructure de Recharge de Véhicules Électriques) commissioned in the department of Ille-et-Vilaine by the Syndicat Départemental d'Énergie 35 (SDE35). Coverage: Syndicat Départemental d'Energie d'Ille-et-Vilaine. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging stations of the SDE35 in the department of Ille-et-Vilaine" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Départemental d'Energie d'Ille-et-Vilaine. Its keywords include borne-de-recharge, syndicat-departemental-energie, mobilite, ille-et-vilaine, irve, borne. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-04-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
